content: Yesu ꞌina toholohila
Sabatiina ꞌigumwala, ma Meli Magidala ma ꞌina waliyesa, tauna Yemesa sinana, ma Salome wete baꞌidadiu holowa bwebweꞌana sigimwaneya ma ꞌabehega Yesu wahina ꞌoinega siheholoi.
Gona ꞌiꞌadaleya beno wiki ꞌana sabwelo nugenugetaina ꞌoina, ma sinala ꞌina saehohau ꞌoina wahiwahineyedi maꞌidi holowa sinaonaoma Yesu galihinaina ꞌoina.
Ma siboidimo sihehegwaegwae, sigwaeya, “Taiya nata ꞌahubodaina galihina ꞌahwanega ꞌida buihile weyahida?” Weyahina daꞌuleina madou hedada.
Ma siloꞌita naowa, galihaina ꞌana ꞌahuboda daꞌuleina ꞌahwanega ꞌibuihileya, ꞌimiyamiya.
Coinega wahiwahineyedi galiha ꞌalona siluhuwa, ma ꞌidi ꞌebeulega hewali maꞌana ꞌaleꞌo waꞌewaꞌeꞌena ꞌimiyamiya siꞌiteya, ma siꞌateyohowa.

Ma hewaliina ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena waꞌateꞌateyoho. Yesu gwama Nasaleta, tauna sigihe keloseya waꞌebeꞌebese, ma geya tauna ꞌebwa ꞌimiyamiya, weyahina tauna ꞌitoholo hila. Cina ꞌebeꞌeno bewa waꞌiteya galihinamo.
Hesi wahila ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya ta wete Pita ꞌoina wahepwaila, wagwae, ‘Yesu nata ꞌinugeta Galili, ma ꞌomi wamuliya, ma nage ꞌoina waꞌita, gide mwalo ꞌina hepwaila ꞌoimiya.’”
Coinega wahiwahineyedi galihega silatu mwayamwayauma ma sidena, weyahina nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa, ma wete sidedededela, maꞌidi ꞌateyoho ta geya ꞌeta taiya ꞌoina sihepwaila.
Yesu ꞌina hapwesa Meli Magidala ꞌoina
Wiki ꞌana sabwelo nugenugetaina gonagona, Yesu ꞌina toholohila ꞌoina ꞌilatu nugeta Meli Magidala ꞌoina, tauna ꞌalonega mwalo hiꞌahiꞌa site sebeni Yesu ꞌiula latuhediya.
Coinega Meliina ꞌinaoma ma Yesu ꞌina tomota ꞌihemataluwediya, ta taudi tuwa ꞌabwa maꞌidi nuwagala sidoudou Yesu weyahina.
Ma Meli hemataluwa ꞌiꞌebwaediya ꞌigwae, “Yesu yaꞌiteya mayawasina.” Ta taudi siꞌahwa ꞌaboꞌaboweya.
Yesu ꞌina helobaloba ꞌana tomuliyao site luwa ꞌoidiya
Ma muliyetega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌeluwa Yelusalemega sihapwesama ma hali ꞌasa weyahina sitautauya, ma Yesu ꞌiꞌabilatuheya ꞌiboi hali ꞌita ꞌoinega.
Eeta site luwaedi sigogona sihila Yelusalema, ma ꞌiyadiyao sihemataluwediya, ma hesi geya sihemisaedi.
Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌidi paihowa ꞌiꞌebwaediya

Muliyetega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao site lebeni siꞌaiꞌai, ma Yesu matadiya ꞌilatuwa, ma ꞌiheliyediya ꞌidi nuwapota weyahina, ꞌigwaeya, “Ciyadao taudi ꞌigu toholohila mulina siꞌitegauwa ta ꞌoimiya sihehepwaila, ma togidega ta geya wahemisaedi?”
Coinega hemataluwa ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Watauya tupwa mabwaiyana, ma wasagu tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya waguguyae.
Eema taiyewedi sihemisaegauwa waꞌabihe babitaisowedi ma lema bwebweꞌana siloba, ma ꞌeguma taiyewedi geya sihemisaegau ꞌabwa loina galana siloba.
“Ma ꞌagu tohemisaowedi ꞌilaꞌilala waiwaidi ꞌabwa sipaihowadi, beno saniguwega hiꞌahiꞌa tomota ꞌoidiyega siulalatuhedi, ma ꞌenana hagana ma hagana ꞌoidiyega sihehe gwaegwae,

ma ꞌeguma mwata lolosasadi siꞌabi lagasidi, geyaꞌabwa ꞌidi ꞌenali ꞌoidiyega siꞌamaꞌamasa. Wete weꞌaha newanewalina ꞌeguma sinuma geyaꞌabwa siꞌamaꞌamasa. Ta wete ꞌeguma tolohalao siꞌabitohodi, sibwebweꞌana tuwa.”
Yesu ꞌina hane galewa
Cida Bada Yesu ꞌina hemataluwa ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya ꞌilosaloha pwaiya ma ꞌihaneya galewa, ma Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeulega ꞌimiyatoiya.

Ta ꞌoinega ꞌana tomuliyaowedi sitauya tupwa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya ma Yesu wasana siguguyaeya, ma hesi Badaina baꞌidadiu sipaipaihowa, ta ꞌina waiwai ꞌoinega paihowaedi ꞌebe henainaida sipaihowediya, ma ꞌoinega tomota wasaina sihemisaeya.
